items.question: What happens if I go over my events?
items.answer: Nothing breaks. Extra events are billed at $0.40 per 100k at the end of the month, and we email you at 80% and 100% of your allowance.

items.question: How much do I save paying yearly?
items.answer: Pro is {{pro.yearly}} a month billed yearly instead of {{pro.monthly}} monthly — two months free, roughly 20%.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Any time, from Settings › Billing. Upgrades are prorated to the day; downgrades take effect at the next renewal.

items.question: Do you accept invoices and purchase orders?
items.answer: On Team (yearly) and Enterprise, yes — net-30 by ACH or wire. Everyone else pays by card.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Pro and Team have a 14-day trial with no card required. Hobby is free forever.
